$Comment: The Great Turkey's hard daily Claim, the bigger one on the hard way in: its hard fight's script grants it at its death, and each player who fought it finds one in the chest where it fell (and on their Claims tab), rolled from Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Daily_Hard and scaled by their share of the fight (ShareScaled). Diminish is left out, so the first hard win each day pays and later hard wins that day pay nothing; a roll that lands nothing never spends the day. It is counted under the hard fight's own script and this reward's own id, so it never spends the normal fight's daily Claim, and a player can collect both on one day. Its row is titled with the hard fight's own name.
